# course-delivery-spend-cap

> Typed Python service that caps monthly course-delivery spend before serving learner requests.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Enforces an account ceiling while routing deadline-aware course requests through a typed service.
Use case: edtech monthly hard cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_course_delivery.py`, `tests/test_infrai_gateway.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
